order.title: Gray-code counter that goes 00, 01, 11, 10 and then starts over
order.spec: Gray-code counter that goes 00, 01, 11, 10 and then starts over. The output q1, q0 shows the count as a binary number (q0 is the smallest digit); it starts at 0 and moves on one step every time the clock ticks.

definition_of_done: State Sequence: After power-up/reset, outputs q1,q0 = 00. On each rising clock edge, state advances through 00 → 01 → 11 → 10 → 00, repeating indefinitely.
Initial State: Verified that initial state is 00 (spec: "state starts at 0").
Clock Edge Sensitivity: State transitions occur exactly on clock ticks; no unwanted combinational transitions.

Gate Integrity (L001): Every instantiated gate has a unique name, a valid type (AND, OR, XOR, NOT), exactly 1 or 2 inputs, and exactly 1 output. No gate name is reused as a signal name, and every output wire maps to a defined gate output or flip‑flip output.

Output Mapping (L003/L004): All output signals (q1, q0) are driven by exactly one source. Connections are unambiguous and match port definitions if library parts are used; for custom gates, pin‑out is explicit.
Fan‑Out Limit (L005/L006): No signal drives more than 4 gate inputs. Total fan‑out per node is counted before handoff; depth from inputs to outputs respects rule constraints.
No Unused Gates (L006): Every gate's output is connected to at least one gate input or output. No orphan gates whose outputs feed nothing.
Allowed Components Only: Design uses only AND, OR, XOR, NOT gates and D flip‑flops (each with input `d` and output named after the flip‑flop). No other gate types or sequential elements.

Input Compliance: Only `clock` is an external input (spec implies clock‑ticked operation; the dot in "Inputs: ." indicates no other inputs). No reset port is required if state is preset to 0 at power‑up, but if a reset pin is added it must be handled correctly.

AutoFab Inspector Verification: Design passes automated checks on every possible input pattern (clock toggles, initial state 00). The inspector never trusts claims—all 4 states and all clock‑edge transitions are enumerated and verified.

parts.name: gray_code_counter_2bit
parts.spec: A 2‑bit Gray‑code counter that cycles through states 00, 01, 11, 10 on each clock tick, starting from 00, with outputs q1 (MSB) and q0 (LSB) representing the count.
